app.name: Tablet App for Mac
app.language.note: Non-English text may still be refined.
startup.toggle: Start automatically when I log in
startup.description: Your tablet only works while Tablet App for Mac is running. If this is off, open Tablet App for Mac each time before using your tablet.
startup.approval_needed: macOS is waiting for your approval: turn Tablet App for Mac on in System Settings › General › Login Items.
startup.unavailable: Start at login isn't available on this Mac. Open the app yourself before using your tablet, or add it in System Settings › General › Login Items.
startup.windows.toggle: Start Tablet App for Mac when Windows starts
startup.windows.description: Launches minimized to the tray at sign-in, so hotkeys are ready without opening it yourself.
startup.unavailable_platform: Run at startup isn't available on this platform.
autostart.title: Start Tablet App for Mac automatically when you log in?
autostart.body: Your tablet only works while Tablet App for Mac is running. If you choose Manually, open Tablet App for Mac each time before using your tablet.
autostart.later_hint: You can change this later in Settings › System.
tray.tooltip: Tablet App for Mac. Your tablet works while this is running
tray.tooltip_status: Tablet App for Mac — {status}. Your tablet works while this is running.
tray.quit_warning: Your tablet will stop working until you open Tablet App for Mac again.
save.tip: Save settings so they survive a driver restart (Cmd+S).
save.tip_unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Save settings so they survive a driver restart (Cmd+S).
save.dialog.quit_body: Save changes before quitting? If the driver isn't running, they are kept and restored next time you open the app.
save.dialog.unsaved_body: Save your current settings before continuing? Unsaved changes may be lost when the driver restarts or another preset is loaded. Continuing does not undo changes already running on the driver.
home.about_blurb: Tablet App for Mac is a free, artist-friendly tablet app.
home.licence_blurb: Tablet App for Mac is a modified version based on OpenTabletArtist and OpenTabletDriver. OpenTabletArtist is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0); OpenTabletDriver is licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 (LGPL-3.0). This program comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY. The full licence texts are in the LICENSES folder and NOTICE file of the download, and the source code is available from the Source code link.
update.prompt_body: Update now? The app downloads it, checks it, and reopens by itself. Your settings stay. If macOS asks for the permissions again, the setup window walks you through it.
setup.title: Set up Tablet App for Mac
setup.wacom.warning: The Wacom driver is still installed. It can stop this app from using your tablet. Remove it first with Wacom's own uninstaller, then restart your Mac. If you don't have Wacom's uninstaller, use a cleaner such as App Cleaner.
setup.wacom.howto: In Wacom Tablet Utility, under Tablet Software, click Uninstall. This app only removes empty leftover folders, never the full driver.
setup.wacom.no_uninstaller: Wacom's uninstaller isn't on this Mac, so the driver may already be removed. Opening Wacom's removal guide instead.
setup.wacom.leftover: Some files from the Wacom driver are still on this Mac. They're usually harmless. If the tablet misbehaves, see Wacom's removal guide.
setup.wacom.howto_no_utility: Wacom Tablet Utility isn't on this Mac. If only empty leftover folders remain, click Remove leftovers. For a full driver, use Wacom's removal guide or a cleaner such as App Cleaner.
setup.wacom.remove_failed: Couldn't remove some leftovers (needs permission). Use Wacom's removal guide, or a cleaner such as App Cleaner.
setup.pen.header: Let the app read your pen
setup.pen.body: Click the button. In the list that opens, find Tablet App for Mac and turn its switch on. If macOS asks, click Allow.
setup.pen.stale: Is the switch already on? It may be left over from an earlier version. Simply turning it off and on again is not enough. Select Tablet App for Mac, click − to remove it, then click + and add it again from Applications.
setup.pointer.header: Let the pen move the pointer
setup.pointer.body: Click the button. In the list that opens ({pane}), find Tablet App for Mac and turn its switch on, as in the picture.
setup.pointer.stale: Is the switch already on? It may be left over from an earlier version. Simply turning it off and on again is not enough. Select Tablet App for Mac, click − to remove it, then click + and add it again from Applications.
setup.restart.body: macOS only lets the pen work after the app starts again. Click the button; the app closes and opens again by itself.
setup.done.body: Your pen is ready. Try it in Scribble.
perm.remove_readd_twice: After a new build, remove Tablet App for Mac from the list and add it again from Applications in both places — Input Monitoring and Accessibility (or Device Control and Data Access) — so macOS recognises it. Simply turning the switch off and on is not enough.
tablet.pen.manual_tip_note: Used for every stroke while pressure sensitivity is off.
tablet.pen.test_buttons: Press a pen button to test it.
tablet.ring.show_hud: Show touch ring setting (on-screen mode display)
scribble.pointer_only_note: Pointer-only mode doesn't draw, so you won't see the dynamics above. Pick a pressure Mode to see them.
plugins.dir_unavailable: Plugin directory not available (is the driver connected?).
tablet.pen.shared_curve: Shared with Pen (one curve for tip and eraser).
tablet.eraser.heading: Eraser
tablet.eraser.manual_note: Used for every eraser stroke while pressure sensitivity is off.
tablet.eraser.pressure_shared: Pressure sensitivity is shared with Pen.
tablet.expresskeys.body: The keys on the tablet itself, not on the pen. Each one can hold a keyboard shortcut, a mouse button or a scroll, and they belong to this tablet's profile.
tablet.expresskeys.press_hint: Press a key on the tablet to light its row here.
tablet.expresskeys.enable_note: Enable buttons switches every key off without deleting anything, for when one sits where your hand rests. Turn it back on and your mappings return.
tablet.about.name: Name
tablet.app.add_tip: Add an application with its own ExpressKeys, Touch Ring and pen bindings.
tablet.app.add_body: Choose a running application, or browse for one in the Applications folder. Each listed app can have its own ExpressKeys, Touch Ring and pen bindings. Mapping and pressure stay on All other.
tablet.app.browse_invalid: That does not look like a macOS application (.app).
tablet.app.remove_body: Remove settings for {name}? ExpressKeys and pen bindings for that app go back to All other.
tablet.app.bindings_only_note: This application has its own ExpressKeys, Touch Ring and pen bindings. Mapping and pressure use All other.
update.ready_body: The update is downloaded and checked. Install now? The app will reopen. Your settings stay. If macOS asks for the permissions again, the setup window walks you through it.
update.available_both: Version {version} is available. You can also try Version {beta} (not tested yet).
update.beta_available: You have the newest stable version. Version {beta} is available to try (not tested yet).
update.on_beta: You're using a BETA. You can go back to the stable Version {version} at any time.
update.on_beta_newer: A newer BETA, Version {beta}, is available. Or go back to the stable Version {version}.
update.beta_body: A BETA has new features that are not tested yet, so something may not work. The app downloads it, checks it, and reopens by itself. Your settings stay. You can go back to the stable version at any time with Check for updates now. Please tell us how it went with Feedback on Home.
update.go_back_body: This replaces the BETA with the stable version. The app downloads it, checks it, and reopens by itself. Your settings stay. If macOS asks for the permissions again, the setup window walks you through it.
update.choose_stable_line: Version {version}: the newest stable version. Recommended.
update.choose_beta_line: Version {beta}: a BETA with new features, not tested yet. Help us test it.
update.choose_go_back_line: Version {version}: the stable version, if the BETA gives you trouble.
update.earlier_heading: Go back to an earlier version
update.earlier_body: Choose the version to go back to. The app downloads it, checks it, and reopens by itself. Your settings stay. If macOS asks for the permissions again, the setup window walks you through it. The earlier version may offer this one again at its weekly update check; choose Not now to stay on it.
update.earlier_none: Couldn't find an earlier version right now. Check the internet connection and try again.
